title: Optimize Font Rendering: Master CSS 'text-rendering' for Sharper UI & UX
tweet: Boost your web typography! Learn how CSS 'text-rendering' enhances font clarity & UI visuals, providing a superior #UX. Get sharper text with this overlooked CSS property. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign
tip: While 'text-rendering: optimizeLegibility' can significantly improve character spacing and ligature display for better UI readability, always test its performance impact, especially on mobile devices or pages with heavy text. For smaller text or headings where geometric accuracy is paramount, 'geometricPrecision' can prevent pixel snapping issues common with default rendering engines. Combine with 'font-smoothing' properties for complete control.
